profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer/Solutions Architect at VSolvit, Inc.
profile.summary:
Versatile, highly motivated, goal-oriented, performance-driven IT professional experienced in the roles of software developer, engineer, technical lead, and architect. Extensive experience in Java Enterprise Edition (J2EE) based client-server applications and enterprise integration applications. Highly accomplished architect and developer of real-time control systems for the management of embedded networking and communications equipment. Adept at design, implementation, and delivery of robust, high quality, mission critical software products. Experienced in the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Proficient in the Agile, Scrum and Waterfall methodologies. 

AREAS OF EXPERTISE:
•	Software Engineering
•	High-level Design & Architecture
•	Java Enterprise Edition 
•	Coding & Implementation
•	Model Based Development
•	Red Hat Enterprise Application Platform (EAP)
•	Red Hat Fuse
•	Apache Camel
•	Red Hat JBoss Data Virtualization (JDV) - Teiid
•	Real-time Control of Embedded Equipment
•	Testing and Quality Control
•	Java Open Source Development 	
•	Geospatial Application Development
•	Web Services
•	User Interface Design
•	Object-Oriented Design and Programming 
•	Client Server Application Development
•	RF & Telecommunications 
•	Technical Leadership/Project Management
•	Rapid Mastery of new Technologies
•	Microsoft Development Environment
•	Embedded Development
•	Android Application Development
•	Web Application Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Solutions Architect
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer/Solution Architect for Navy software development program.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Lead Systems Engineer/Lead Architect
positions.locationName: Norfolk City County, Virginia, United States
positions.description:
Lead Architect for the Operational Supply project. Operational Supply is a SOA based web application for Navy supply management and logistics support built on the Red Hat EAP application server. Led the architecture/engineering team responsible for performing the requirements analysis and developing the system architecture and detailed system design in the Sparx Enterprise Architect UML modeling tool. Also, wrote the System Architecture Document (SAD) and the Software Design Document (SDD) deliverables. After completion of the requirements and design phases of the project, joined the development team to assist in coding the application while continuing to support the entire development team as the Lead Architect. 

Lead Systems Engineer (LSE) for the Single Supply Baseline (SSB) component of the Navy Tactical Command Support System – Open Architecture (NTCSS-OA) program. NTCSS-OA is a Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) framework that hosts multiple data center based applications that together replace numerous legacy shipboard and ashore tactical support systems. As the SSB LSE worked with the NTCSS-OA LSE and Lead Systems Architect (LSA) and the LSEs for other NTCSS-OA components to help define the architecture and high level system design, document the design and communicate it to the development teams. Worked closely with the SSB development teams to help resolve technical issues. Worked with the engineering team, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, the technical leads of the development teams, build support team, IV&V, and senior management to help ensure clear communications between all layers of the project. Stayed hands-on with the technologies leveraged by the NTCSS-OA application stack including Red Hat supported JBoss Enterprise Platform (EAP), JBoss Enterprise Service Bus (ESB), JBoss jBPM workflow manager, JBoss Drools, Hibernate, Oracle, JavaScript, Spring, Spring MVC, DOJO and Maven.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Lead Systems Engineer/Lead Architect
positions.description:
Developed Apache Camel based interface applications for retrieving personnel and medical data from external business partners including the Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC) and the Defense Medical Information Exchange (DMIX) and loading the data into the COHORT (Oracle) and HSDW (Teradata) databases that are part of the Medical Information Delivery System Engineering Support (MIDSES) Agile Core Services Data Access Layer (ACS-DAL) system. The Camel applications are deployed to the Red Hat supported version of the Fuse/EAP/JBoss application server. The interfaces use the Apache CXF SOAP web-services library, REST web-services, SFTP, etc., to retrieve data from the external business partners. The implementation of the interfaces includes XML parsing, XML validation through the development of an XSD schema, JSON, input validation using JSR-303 and the Hibernate Validator library and the use of JPA/Hibernate in order to abstract the access to the Oracle and Teradata databases. The ACS-DAL system provides an aggregated data warehouse for access by researchers and analysts with both the Veterans Administration (VA) and the Defense Health Agency (DHA) by combining data from both organizations as well as other third-party sources.

Developed a virtual database (VDB) utilizing the Red Hat supported JBoss Data Virtualization (JDV) product. The VDB combined tables from multiple underlying databases providing a single aggregated view of the data. The VDB also converted data types into a single canonical form for the virtual view layer. The VDB was fully updateable supporting the Select, Insert, Update and Delete operations. Developed an ACS-DAL Camel based application that accessed the VDB through the Teiid JDBC database driver.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Lead Systems Engineer/Lead Architect
positions.description: Designed the software architecture for the Command Individual Risk and Resiliency Assessment System (CIRRAS) for the USMC and developed the initial full-stack skeleton of the architecture. The technology stack includes Angular, Spring MVC, EJB, Hibernate and Apache Camel. The system runs on Red Hat supported Fuse and EAP servers in AWS and utilizes AWS RDS MySql for the database. Developed the CAC based user authentication/authorization service to provide roll-based access to the application. Continued developing additional functional features of the application.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Technical Lead\Architect, Project Manager
positions.description:
Technical Lead and Chief Architect in support of the Office of Naval Research (ONR) and the Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command (SPAWAR) on several projects, to develop state-of-the-art Management and Control (M&C) technologies for Naval and DoD C4ISR, networking, and communications systems.  

eXtensible Communications Automation Framework and Environment (XCAFE): Engineered and provided technical leadership for the XCAFE framework; a generic run-time environment and higher-order management and control (M&C) framework based on the open source JBoss J2EE application server. XCAFE includes the XCAFE Developers Kit (XDK) which provides code generation tools easing the development of new components.  

Led the design and development of the XCAFE based xViz application for data collection, aggregation, visualization, situational awareness and control. The xViz application provides situational awareness of critical communications and networking assets in Navy and Coast Guard ships and DISA shore facilities. xViz allows custom dashboards to be built with drag-n-drop functionality much like building PowerPoint slides. The dashboards are dynamic and render live content collected from multiple systems in real-time. Systems can be monitored via multiple protocols including SNMP, RS-232/422, HTML, SOAP, XML, SQL, GPS, files, etc. xViz was selected as the monitoring solution for the Coast Guard’s SEAWATCH C4ISR system.

Developed an automated Bandwidth Manager agent based on the JESS rules engine for the naval radio room. The Expert Systems agent monitors user provided priorities, desired bandwidth, desired Quality of Service, the available bandwidth and up\down status of the various satellite and line-of-sight communications links and controls the shipboard communications network equipment to ensure the highest priority traffic is given optimal service through the best egress. Selected one of ten applications for immediate transition to the fleet in Trident Warrior.

company.name: Sotera Defense Solutions, Inc., Formerly Global Strategies Group, Formerly SFA, Inc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, implementation, and team management of object-oriented Windows applications for control and configuration of embedded equipment for the television broadcast industry, including networking support using sockets. Experience includes C, C++, WIN16 and WIN32 APIs, Microsoft Foundation Class Library (MFC), Active-X, Templates, TCP/IP, sockets, etc. 

Developed the Panel Mapper Windows MFC application for configuration of programmable hardware control panels. The application allows the user to configure a database of the equipment installed in a broadcast facility and allows virtualization of the hardware. Various aspects of the virtual configuration can then be assigned to the buttons and menus of the hardware control panels. 

Developed the Router Works suite of Windows MFC applications for control of multiple levels of signal switching routers (video, audio, data, digital video, digital audio, time code, etc.) These applications share the same hardware configuration and virtualization database as the Panel Mapper application and allow the user to control the same broadcast hardware from a Windows PC. Client-server support is provided to allow multiple PCs to control the same hardware via the network. 

Design and implementation of embedded hardware for the television broadcast industry using the Motorola 68HC11 microprocessor including the popular RCP-ANXY control panel. Also, developed the embedded firmware using assembly language and C. 

Design and implementation of automated test systems for television broadcast equipment using object-oriented DOS based applications to integrate a Tektronix VM-700 Video Analyzer, HP Network Analyzer, and Audio Precision System-One.

positions.title: Communications Technician (NABER Certified)
positions.description:
Performed component level repair on all product lines of Motorola fixed and mobile communications equipment, including two-way mobile radios, trunked mobiles, base stations, repeaters, paging terminals, IMTS mobile telephones, and cellular mobiles and terminal equipment. 

Performed component level repair on commercial audio equipment and closed circuit television systems.

positions.title: Avionic Navigation Systems Technician
positions.description: Maintained and repaired avionic systems such as Search and Weather Radar, Precision Ground Mapping Radar, Station Keeping Radar, IFF/Transponders, TACAN, VOR/ILS, and ADF.
